spans.s:
n. (-लं)
Good, happiness, welfare, prosperity.
E.
भदि to be auspicious, Uṇādi aff. इलच्.

A ray of light.
4 A master.
5 A sovereign, a prince.
6 The father of the fifteenth Jaina pontiff.
7 Beauty.
f. (-नुः)
A handsome woman.
E.
भा to shine, Uṇādi aff. नु.

f. (-ला)
The plantain, (Musa sapientum.)
E.
भानु the sun, फल the fruit; being offered in the worship of the sun.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Luminous, splendid, resplendent.
2 Beautiful, handsome.
m. (-मान्)
The sun.
E.
भानु light, मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-रः)
Sunday.
E.
भानु the sun, and वार a day.

m. (-मिः)
The sun.
E.
भा light, नेमि circumference.
